_readme: Every hand-made asset the game knows how to use, other than card art.
Card art is deliberately NOT here: it binds by card id with no registration
step, and listing 296 filenames would be a second copy of data/cards to keep
in sync. Everything below is different — a fixed, small set the code refers
to by name, so naming it once and reading it from both the loader and the
verifier is what stops those two disagreeing.
A missing file is NOT an error. Every one of these degrades: icons fall back
to the procedural drawing the game has always used, boards fall back to the
flat clear colour, the logo falls back to the inline SVG. `npm run
verify:assets` reports coverage and only fails on a file that is present and
wrong — wrong size, wrong format, or one a browser cannot decode.
Sizes are exact and enforced. An icon that is 500x512 is a bug that shows up
as a hairline misalignment nobody can find later.

assets.note: the HB monogram badge; every favicon and the .exe icon are downscales of this
the word HYPEBOUND, for the main menu

_note: One per faction, plus `default` for anything unfactioned and `boss` for
boss encounters. Chosen by the OPPONENT's faction, because the backdrop is
the place you have been dragged to, not the one you brought.
